questions: What does the ONNX classifier stub need to become a working candle-onnx classifier (#72)?
What is the embedder template + tokenizer scope boundary?
How to test the classifier without a committed model fixture?

findings.summary: OnnxClassifier holds _model: Option<()> placeholder; classify_text is a fail-loud stub (classifier.rs:12-42). Implements OnnxModel trait (capabilities=TextClassification correct).

Template = OnnxEmbedder::embed_text_onnx (embedder.rs:64-92): model check -> simple_tokenize -> build_transformer_inputs(input_ids/attention_mask/token_type_ids) -> candle_onnx::simple_eval -> post-process. Mirror for classifier: extract logits [1,num_labels] -> softmax -> argmax -> ClassificationResult{label,confidence,all_labels}.
Tokenizer: simple_tokenize is naive hash (embedder.rs:118-130); mirroring it suffices for #72 scope-1 (real tokenizer = scope-2, out of scope).

ClassificationResult{label,confidence,all_labels:Vec<(String,f32)>} (engine/output.rs:14-23); labels from OnnxClassifier::new(model_id, labels). softmax pattern in moe/router.rs:69-75. load_onnx_model hardcodes embedder (mod.rs:70-80) -> add load_onnx_classifier.

Fixtures fixtures/models/onnx/ (gitignored): tinybert-classifier.onnx 22KB, bert-mini-classifier.onnx 260MB. Tests skip gracefully if absent (tier2 test:19-24). Pure logits->ClassificationResult helper is CI-testable with synthetic tensor (no fixture).
